offence_note: Possession for trafficking cocaine, proceeds of crime, breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: we are of the view that the appropriate disposition is one of time served plus 3 years probation on terms and conditions agreed to by the parties and approved by the court.
note: Crown appeal; CSO set aside; Indigenous status inferred from Gladue Afterwork Worker.

offence_note: Seven bank robberies and failure to stop at accident
sentence_quote: appeals a sentence of ten years in the penitentiary imposed upon him after he pleaded guilty to seven counts of robbery and a single count of failure to stop at the scene of an accident.

offence_note: Break, enter and theft of neighbour's house
sentence_quote: The respondent was sentenced to pay a fine of $2,500.00 or 50 days in default, plus a victim fine surcharge of $250.00 and three years probation.
note: Crown sentence appeal dismissed; probation requires continued psychiatric treatment.

offence_note: Assault, sexual assault and death threats against girlfriend
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to four years’ imprisonment.
note: Conviction and sentence appeals dismissed; no remorse found.

offence_note: Break and enter with theft; possession of stolen property over $5000
co_offenders: Cameron: 1 year consecutive to federal sentence he is serving
sentence_quote: I find that the just and appropriate sanction for that offence is to order Mr. Bowser to serve a term of 30 months of imprisonment in a federal penitentiary.
systemic_quote: I have taken into account the principles of proportionality, totality and as well as a consideration of the Gladue factors which Mr. Cameron has personally experienced.
note: Victim surcharge waived; Bowser 30 months total with concurrent 1 year.

offence_note: Invitation to sexual touching and unlawful confinement of stepdaughter
sentence_quote: I sentence Mr. Norberg to a period of seven years' imprisonment.
note: Eight months concurrent for confinement; no-contact order applies in custody.

offence_note: Aggravated assault by stabbing in neck
sentence_quote: This amounts to 6 ½ months of credit to be deducted from the sentence of three years.
note: Double credit; victim surcharge waived; weapons prohibition ten years after release.

offence_note: Three thefts at drug store as party
sentence_quote: The trial judge sentenced the appellant to a term of imprisonment of six months (two months times three), as well as to two years’ probation
note: Victim surcharge struck on appeal; otherwise sentence stands.

offence_note: Obscenity: making and distributing obscene material
sentence_quote: I would dismiss the appeal with respect to count 7 and vary the sentence to a $2,000 fine.
note: New trial ordered on counts 3-6; only count 7 sentence fixed.

offence_note: Counselling two persons to murder her husband
sentence_quote: I find that the appropriate sentence in the circumstances of your case is seven years in prison.
note: Credit: 2 months pre-sentence custody plus 4 months for bail; surcharge waived.

offence_note: Manslaughter in gang attack at schoolyard
sentence_quote: Mr. Scotchman, I sentence you to a period of imprisonment for seven years.
note: Credit 34 months actual custody at 1.5:1 per court; Gladue considered but no stated effect.
